original.statement: FindZoneByFqdn now caches the full DNS response and handles TTL expiration.

decision.reason: [ev-d4918828336e] says that in 1.18.0, `FindZoneByFqdn` now caches the full DNS response and handles TTL expiration. This changes how DNS zone lookups behave at runtime without changing any configuration, so "behavior-changed" is the right change type. The subject name "findzonebyfqdn-dns-response-caching" is lowercase kebab-case and uses only the excerpt's own key words, so the protocol-behavior subject fits. The validators could not check this either way, because this kind of change can't be verified from rendered artifacts.
